_how_to: A review object for one file. Written by the person or assistant who actually checked the text, after drafting. Get text_sha256 with: python3 scripts/workflow_quality.py <file> (add --writing for answers and letters). Do not fill positive notes from a clean automated run; the notes must say what was checked.

claim_checks.source: ledger claim or dated user statement

role_match: Which central needs of the role the file answers, and with which evidence.
proofreading: What was checked: names, title, dates, grammar.
visual_review: How the rendered pages were inspected (PDF and DOCX attachments only).

warning_resolutions.gap_disclaimer: A concrete reason for keeping flagged wording, if any.
